name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
scopeNote: Full ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A catalog (93 controls across 4 themes). ISO is an information-security management standard: most Organizational, People, and Physical controls are evidenced by policy, process, and facility records. SAST/SCA provides direct evidence chiefly for the Technological controls on secure development (A.8.25–A.8.29), technical vulnerabilities (A.8.8), cryptography (A.8.24), and access restriction (A.8.3/8.5).

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.summary: Information security policy and topic-specific policies are defined, approved, and reviewed.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.summary: Security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.summary: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are segregated.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.summary: Management requires personnel to apply information security per policy.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.summary: Contact with relevant authorities is maintained.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.summary: Contact with special interest groups and security forums is maintained.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.summary: Information about threats is collected and analyzed to produce threat intelligence.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.summary: Information security is integrated into project management.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.summary: An inventory of information and associated assets is developed and maintained.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.summary: Rules for acceptable use of assets are identified and implemented.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.summary: Personnel return organizational assets upon change or termination.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.summary: Information is classified according to security needs.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.summary: Procedures for information labelling are implemented.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.summary: Rules and controls for information transfer are in place.

controls.title: Access control
controls.summary: Rules to control physical and logical access are established based on requirements.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.summary: The full lifecycle of identities is managed.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.summary: Allocation and management of authentication information is controlled.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.summary: Access rights are provisioned, reviewed, and revoked per policy.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.summary: Processes manage security risks from supplier products and services.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.summary: Security requirements are established in supplier agreements.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.summary: Security risks in the ICT products and services supply chain are managed.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.summary: Supplier service delivery is monitored and changes managed.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.summary: Cloud service acquisition, use, and exit are managed for security.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.summary: Incident management is planned and prepared.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.summary: Security events are assessed and categorized.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.summary: Incidents are responded to per documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.summary: Knowledge from incidents is used to strengthen controls.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.summary: Procedures for identification and collection of evidence are defined.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.summary: Security is maintained during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.summary: ICT readiness is planned and tested for continuity.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.summary: Relevant requirements are identified and met.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.summary: IP rights and licensing are protected.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.summary: Records are protected from loss, destruction, and unauthorized access.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.summary: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information is ensured.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.summary: The security approach is independently reviewed at intervals.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.summary: Compliance with security policies and standards is regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.summary: Operating procedures are documented and available.

controls.title: Screening
controls.summary: Background verification checks are carried out.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.summary: Employment agreements state security responsibilities.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.summary: Personnel receive security awareness and training.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.summary: A disciplinary process for security violations is formalized.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.summary: Security responsibilities that remain valid after termination are defined.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.summary: NDAs reflecting protection needs are maintained.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.summary: Security measures for remote working are implemented.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.summary: Personnel report observed security events through appropriate channels.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.summary: Security perimeters protect areas with information assets.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.summary: Secure areas are protected by entry controls.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.summary: Physical security for offices and facilities is implemented.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.summary: Premises are monitored for unauthorized physical access.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.summary: Protection against physical and environmental threats is provided.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.summary: Security measures for working in secure areas are defined.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.summary: Clear desk and clear screen rules are enforced.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.summary: Equipment is sited and protected securely.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.summary: Off-site assets are protected.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.summary: Storage media are managed through their lifecycle.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.summary: Facilities are protected from utility failures.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.summary: Power and telecom cabling is protected.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.summary: Equipment is maintained to ensure availability and integrity.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.summary: Equipment is verified for secure disposal or reuse.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.summary: Information on user endpoint devices is protected.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.summary: Allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.summary: Access to information and other assets is restricted per the access control policy.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.summary: Read and write access to source code, tools, and libraries is managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.summary: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.summary: Resource use is monitored and adjusted to capacity requirements.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.summary: Protection against malware is implemented and supported by awareness.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Information about technical vulnerabilities is obtained and exposure is evaluated and addressed.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.summary: Configurations of hardware, software, and services are established and maintained.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.summary: Information is deleted when no longer required.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.summary: Data masking is used per policy and business requirements.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.summary: Data leakage prevention measures are applied to systems and networks handling sensitive information.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.summary: Backups are maintained and tested.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.summary: Processing facilities have sufficient redundancy.

controls.title: Logging
controls.summary: Logs recording activities, exceptions, and events are produced, stored, and protected.
evidenceExamples: Insufficient logging / sensitive data in logs findings

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.summary: Networks and systems are monitored for anomalous behaviour.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.summary: System clocks are synchronized to approved time sources.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.summary: Use of utility programs that can override controls is restricted.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.summary: Procedures manage software installation on operational systems.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.summary: Networks and devices are secured and managed.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.summary: Security mechanisms and service levels for network services are managed.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.summary: Groups of services and systems are segregated on networks.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.summary: Access to external websites is managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.summary: Rules for effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined and implemented.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.summary: Rules for the secure development of software and systems are established and applied.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.summary: Information security requirements are identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.summary: Principles for engineering secure systems are established and applied.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.summary: Secure coding principles are applied to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.summary: Security testing processes are defined and implemented in the development lifecycle.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.summary: Outsourced system development is directed, monitored, and reviewed.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.summary: Development, test, and production environments are separated and secured.

controls.title: Change management
controls.summary: Changes to information processing facilities and systems are subject to change management.

controls.title: Test information
controls.summary: Test information is selected, protected, and managed.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.summary: Audit tests of operational systems are planned and agreed to minimize disruption.
